meta.promptText: Which brand's kurta sets should I buy for women online in India?

response.text:
If you’re shopping online in India, I’d shortlist these brands rather than buying from random marketplace labels:

| Brand | Best for | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Biba** | Everyday + office | Reliable, feminine, lots of cotton/printed sets |
| **W for Woman** | Polished office wear | More structured, contemporary |
| **Libas** | Best value/trendy styles | Lots of options around ₹800–₹2,000 |
| **Aurelia** | Dressier/festive sets | Modern silhouettes and embellishment |
| **Fabindia** | Premium, timeless cotton | Handcrafted/artisanal look |
| **Janasya** | Budget-friendly cotton | Good everyday variety |


A recent 2026 comparison found **W** strongest for polished versatility, **Biba** particularly good for practical daily cotton wear, **Fabindia** for timeless/artisanal styles, **Lakshita** for relaxed comfort, and **Aurelia** for dressier occasions. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks

**🥇 Best overall: Biba**  
If you want one brand that's easy to buy from and suitable for work, casual outings and family occasions, I'd start here.

### [Biba Women's Floral Printed Kurta Set]()
*₹2,399*

**💰 Best value: Libas**  
Particularly good if you want several sets without spending too much. Current online selections include cotton and printed sets under ₹1,500–₹2,000. [zoutons.com](https://zoutons.com/news/myntra-kurta-sets-under-2000-trending-styles-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### [Libas Beige Solid Cotton Blend Straight Suit with Dupatta]()
*₹1,809*

**🌿 Best premium/timeless: Fabindia**  
Choose this if you prefer natural-looking cotton, subtle prints and embroidery rather than trend-heavy designs.

### [Fabindia Avni Natural Cotton Printed Kurta & Pant Set]()
*₹2,599*

**✨ Best for office: W for Woman**  
I'd choose W when you want a sharper, more sophisticated kurta set rather than a very traditional look. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**🎉 Best for festive occasions: Aurelia**  
Good middle ground between everyday ethnicwear and heavily embellished occasionwear. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget per set (e.g. ₹1,000 / ₹2,000 / ₹3,000+) and whether you want cotton, office wear, or festive**, I can narrow it down to **5–10 specific sets worth buying right now**.
